Pass email to have a 6-digit code emailed, then call again with email and otp to get a session key (a new email is signed up with 200 free emails a day). Or pass api_key to swap an API key for a session key. Send the key as the HTTP header 'Authorization: Bearer <sessi

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Free daily emails (renewed every day), email credits per dollar, and the packs on sale. No sign-in needed.

tools.name: get_account
tools.description: The signed-in account: email, daily_limit, sent_today, remaining_today, credits_remaining, resets_at.

tools.name: update_account
tools.description: Set the name, company or brand (the look of every email the account sends) on the account.

tools.name: send_email
tools.description: Send one email to one recipient: transactional (receipt, code, alert) or marketing (category). It goes out as HTML in a branded template with a text part; give text, html or both. Uses 1 email of today's allowance. Many recipients at once: send_campaign.

tools.name: send_campaign
tools.description: Send a marketing email to up to 1,000 recipients; the unsubscribe link is added for you. Invalid, role, blocked or unsubscribed recipients are skipped and cost nothing; each accepted recipient uses 1 email of today's allowance. A campaign that doesn't fit what's left today is refused whole.

tools.name: check_email
tools.description: Free deep check of an email address, no sign-in needed: format, provider username rules, disposable and role addresses, and the domain's MX, SPF, DMARC, DKIM, MTA-STS, TLS-RPT and BIMI records. Returns a report with a score (0-99, likelihood the address is real) and a verdict (likely_valid, risky, l

tools.name: check_list
tools.description: List check for a mailing list: up to 1,000 different addresses a call, as emails or the text of a CSV (the column headed email). One status each: valid, risky, role, disposable, no_mx or invalid, with a reason, plus counts per status. Format, provider rules and one MX lookup per domain; no email is

tools.name: validate_email
tools.description: Check an address before sending. Verdicts: ok, invalid, no_mx, disposable, role.

tools.name: block
tools.description: Block an email address or a whole domain for this account. Sends to it are refused.

tools.name: unblock
tools.description: Remove an email address or domain from the blocklist.

tools.name: list_blocklist
tools.description: The account's blocked addresses and domains.

tools.name: add_unsubscribe
tools.description: Record an opt-out. Campaigns to that list (or every list, if list_id is empty) skip the address.

tools.name: buy_pack
tools.description: Start buying a pack (pack_5 = $5, pack_10 = $10, pack_50 = $50; each $1 adds 3,636 email credits, which don't renew and last until used, plus a purchase fee of 5% or at least $0.50 at checkout; GET /v1/pricing has the totals). Returns a checkout_url for a person to pay; the credits arrive once the p

tools.name: order_status
tools.description: Status of an order from buy_pack: pending or paid.

tools.name: create_api_key
tools.description: Create a long-lived API key (max 10 per account). It is shown only once. mode 'test' makes an e59_test_ key for staging and CI: its sends are accepted and stored, never delivered, and use no allowance.

tools.name: list_test_messages
tools.description: Emails sent with a test key (e59_test_...), newest first: accepted, stored, never delivered. Pass id for one email with its html and text (a verify_start code is in there), or to to filter by recipient.

tools.name: list_api_keys
tools.description: The account's API keys (ids and labels, never the keys themselves).

tools.name: verify_start
tools.description: Email a one-time verification code to an address (sign-up, sign-in, confirming an email). email59 makes the code, sends it, limits resends and expires it; the code is never returned to you. Returns an id. Uses 1 email of today's allowance. A new code to the same address replaces the one waiting ther

tools.name: verify_check
tools.description: Check a code from verify_start. Give to (checks the newest code sent there) or id, and code. Returns valid true or false and a status: approved, wrong_code, expired, too_many_attempts (5 wrong codes lock it), already_used, replaced or not_found. A right code works once. Uses no allowance.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "auth" references sensitive artifacts (api_key, authorization, bearer). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "send_email" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "verify_check" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: auth, get_pricing, get_account, check_email, check_list, validate_email, buy_pack, list_test_messages · Private data: auth, check_email, add_unsubscribe, create_api_key, list_api_keys · Public sink: auth, get_pricing, get_account, update_account, send_email, send_campaign, check_email, check_list, validate_email, block, unblock, buy_pack, list_test_messages, verify_start · Destructive: check_email, check_list, unblock.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: auth, get_pricing, get_account, check_email, check_list, validate_email, buy_pack, list_test_messages · Private data: auth, check_email, add_unsubscribe, create_api_key, list_api_keys · Public sink: auth, get_pricing, get_account, update_account, send_email, send_campaign, check_email, check_list, validate_email, block, unblock, buy_pack, list_test_messages, verify_start · Destructive: check_email, check_list, unblock

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
